title: Vampire Vape Rum Tobacco Flavour Concentrate 30ml
description: Vampire Vape Rum Tobacco Concentrate combines the earthy character of Tobacco with the warming sweetness of Rum for a distinctive DIY blend. The Tobacco delivers a full-bodied base, while Rum adds a subtle richness and depth. This concentrate comes in a 30ml bottle and must be diluted before use. It is intended for experienced mixers who prefer to create their own e-liquids, with control over VG/PG balance and nicotine strength. Made in the UK, Vampire Vape concentrates are trusted for their reliable flavour and quality, making them a popular choice for DIY e-liquid enthusiasts.
